question: How many Cricket Asia Cup titles has India won after their victory in the 2025 Asia Cup Final?
solution:
The correct answer is __**9.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India won their 9th Asia Cup title after defeating Pakistan by 5 wickets in the 2025 Asia Cup Final at Dubai International Cricket Stadium.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **India’s win in the Asia Cup 2025 makes it the team with the most Asia Cup titles, with 9 victories.**
 
• **The Man of the Match in the final was Tilak Verma, while Kuldeep Yadav was named the Most Valuable Player of the Tournament.**
 
• **Abhishek Sharma was awarded the Player of the Tournament for his outstanding performance throughout the competition.**
 
• **India has now surpassed Sri Lanka (6 titles) and Pakistan (2 titles) in the number of Asia Cup titles won.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Asia Cup History__

 __
 
• Founded in 1984, the Asia Cup is governed by the Asian Cricket Council (ACC) and is played in alternating formats of ODI and T20I.
 
 
 
• India's Record__
 __
 
• With their 9th win, India holds the record for the most Asia Cup titles.
 
 
 
• Top Performers__
 __
 
• Abhishek Sharma scored the most runs and hit the most sixes in the tournament, while Kuldeep Yadav took the most wickets.
 
 
 
• BCCI's Reward__
 
 
• The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) announced a ₹21 Crore prize for India’s victory in the 2025 Asia Cup.
